title: A HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT!
text: A HUGE DISAPPOINTMENT!. Very disappointed in Lifetime. It's great that this table is adjustable and foldable, however, Lifetime got cheap and made it much more narrow (by 6") than their original 4' tables and, when at the highest adjustment, it's very wobbly. They just don't make 'em like they used to 😔
